text: The Special International Hockey Tournament is hosted on an annual basis in a different North American City. The 2026 tournament will be held in Toronto. The City of Toronto previously hosted this event in 2019. The 2026 tournament is expected to bring in about 60 teams from across Canada, the United States, and England. The tournament is scheduled to be hosted at the Scotiabank Pond Arena in Downsview Park and the Chesswood Arena located at 4000 Chesswood Drive on March 5, 6, and 7, 2026. The City of Toronto is actively involved in hosting international sporting events and is equipped with the resources and capacity to endorse this significant hockey event and ensure its success. Special Hockey is a community-based hockey program for the developmentally challenged that was founded in 1980 by the late Pat Flick.
